decisions.quote:
We were able to reproduce most results
    after solving some issues related to the versions of the software packages used. We
    were ultimately able to reproduce the results reported in the main body of the
    paper.
decisions.reason: The authors reproduced all results in the main body of the paper and most appendix results after resolving software version differences (Stata 13 and reghdfe v3) and obtaining missing appendix variables and code from the original authors, with only minor non-substantive discrepancies remaining in appendix tables. Under the codebook, obtaining the reported numbers for the central findings after resolving software or script issues and author correspondence is coded as computationally reproducible.
